description: Find runnable SBPivot (pivot grid) code examples by feature or use case. Returns ready-to-adapt example snippets (pivotConfig with dataSource and pivot rows/columns/values). limit.description: Maximum number of examples to return. Default 3.

query.description: Feature or use case (e.g. 'Using Pivot', '소계', '집계 함수', 'drillThrough').
